g.text: UART: GND / TX / RX; 3.3 V logic

g.desc: UART: GND / TX / RX; 3.3 V logic

g.text: 5 V and 3.3 V are produced on this board. PWR_FLAG is an ERC marker, not another source.

g.desc: 5 V and 3.3 V are produced on this board. PWR_FLAG is an ERC marker, not another source.

g.text: Only external supply: J1 BATTERY 2S. J2 is the switched battery output to the lamp.

g.desc: Only external supply: J1 BATTERY 2S. J2 is the switched battery output to the lamp.

g.text: Provisional NTC 10k B3950; GPIO1 powers divider only while sampling

g.desc: Provisional NTC 10k B3950; GPIO1 powers divider only while sampling

g.text: EN: R9/C14 power-on delay; SW3 = manual reset

g.desc: EN: R9/C14 power-on delay; SW3 = manual reset

g.text: FLASH: hold BOOT, press/release RESET, release BOOT

g.desc: FLASH: hold BOOT, press/release RESET, release BOOT

g.text: Wires crossing WITHOUT a dot are NOT connected. A dot marks a junction.

g.desc: Wires crossing WITHOUT a dot are NOT connected. A dot marks a junction.

g.text: LAMP SUPPLY IS THE BATTERY VOLTAGE

g.desc: LAMP SUPPLY IS THE BATTERY VOLTAGE

g.text: Shunt 47 mOhm: firmware calibration CAL=1089 at Current_LSB=100 uA. NTC type must match firmware.

g.desc: Shunt 47 mOhm: firmware calibration CAL=1089 at Current_LSB=100 uA. NTC type must match firmware.

g.text: J5: GPIO7 / contact to GND; firmware pull-up required

g.desc: J5: GPIO7 / contact to GND; firmware pull-up required

g.text: 5V = OUTPUT OF U2 + L1, NOT AN EXTERNAL INPUT

g.desc: 5V = OUTPUT OF U2 + L1, NOT AN EXTERNAL INPUT
